title: Accounts Assistant
description:

title: Accounts Payable - Bracknell
description:
We are recruiting an Accounts Payable professional for a full-time contract in Bracknell. The assignment is expected to last three to six months, offers £13.50 per hour PAYE and combines three office days with two days working from home. An ASAP start is required.

The opportunity

You will support a busy finance team by keeping supplier transactions accurate, resolving queries and helping payment activity run smoothly.

What you will be doing
- Process purchase orders, supplier invoices and timesheets.
- Set up and maintain accurate supplier accounts.
- Respond to queries from suppliers and internal colleagues.
- Match invoices to purchase orders and investigate discrepancies.
- Reconcile supplier statements and resolve outstanding items.
- Assist with payment runs and month-end activity.
- Keep dependable accounts payable records.

About you

You will bring practical accounts payable experience, strong attention to detail and a confident approach to resolving invoice and supplier queries. You should be comfortable working at pace, maintaining accurate records and contributing to a collaborative finance team.

Please apply online for consideration.

title: Billing Clerk
description:
Billing Specialist

Location: Datchet - 5 days per week
Salary: £30,000 - £32,000

A growing UK-based business is looking for an experienced Billing Specialist to join its finance team. This is a hands-on role focused on ensuring accurate and timely billing across a multi-entity organisation.

You will work closely with Finance, Credit Control, Operations and other internal stakeholders to manage billing activity, resolve complex queries and ensure invoices are produced accurately and in line with contractual requirements.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced billing professional looking to take ownership of a varied billing function within a growing organisation.

Key responsibilities
- Produce accurate and timely customer invoices across multiple entities.
- Ensure billing is completed in line with contractual terms and agreed deadlines.
- Review billing exceptions and resolve complex invoicing queries.
- Maintain accurate customer pricing, contracts and billing data.
- Investigate discrepancies and ensure billing issues are resolved promptly.
- Work closely with Credit Control to support effective cash collection.
- Perform billing reconciliations and investigate discrepancies.
- Support month-end close and ensure billing deadlines are met.
- Assist with audit requests and provide supporting documentation.
- Produce billing reports and monitor volumes, backlogs and outstanding issues.
- Identify opportunities to improve billing processes, controls and efficiency.
- Support system improvements, automation and wider finance transformation projects.
- Work closely with internal stakeholders to resolve billing disputes and queries.

What we're looking for
- Previous experience within a Billing, Sales Ledger or Accounts Receivable environment.
- Strong understanding of billing processes and financial controls.
- Experience managing complex or high-volume billing activity.
- Excellent attention to detail and a strong focus on accuracy.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines.
- Confident communication skills and the ability to work with stakeholders across a business.
- Strong Excel and finance systems experience.
- A proactive approach with a genuine interest in process improvement.
- The ability to investigate problems, identify solutions and work independently.

What's on offer?
- Salary of £30,000 - £32,000.
- Full training, support and ongoing development.
- Genuine opportunities for career progression.
- Learning and development tailored to your career aspirations.
- Financial wellbeing and employee benefits platform.
- A supportive and collaborative finance environment.
- Opportunity to join a growing organisation and make a genuine impact within the billing function.

Please note: This is a fully office-based position, Monday to Friday, in Datchet.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Expanding Organisation seeks a Credit Controller to join their business on a temporary assignment. The Credit Controller will own and perform collections activity for this organisation having your own book portfolio to minimise debtor balances.

Duties of the Credit Controller include:
- Daily credit control via telephone, letter and email in line with agreed collection cycle and whilst maintaining accurate activity records.
- Produce daily arrears report and report to senior stakeholders on a daily basis.
- Management of external debt collection agencies
- Management of litigation cases as required.
- Update customer records with direct debit mandates.
- Process daily direct debit collections and cash allocation.
- Manage customer queries and complaints in a timely and effective manner.
- Produce monthly arrears report for Board reporting purposes.
- Develop and maintain collection processes and procedures.
- General lease administration of Own Book portfolio including activating and terminating proposals along with raising settlement quotes and invoices.
- Assisting in both internal and external audit as required
- Support the development of processes and procedures through pro-active, constructive challenge and feedback.
- Close collaboration with other members of the Finance team and other departments to ensure key deliverables are achieved.

Requirements for the Credit Controller include:
- 3 Years+ previous credit control experience in a business-to-business environment.
- Minimum GCSE English and Maths both grade B or above.
- Strong systems skills including Microsoft Office
- Conscientious and accurate with attention to detail along with a 'can do' attitude.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills.
- Well organised and able to prioritise and manage a varied workload in a dynamic organisation.
- Strong time management skills.
- Good team player with ability to engage at all levels.

Hybrid working

title: Finance Administrator / Officer - Purchase Ledger
description:
Finance Administrator

Job Type: Permanent
Location: Slough
Working Hours: 09:00 - 17:00
Annual Salary: £35,000

We are seeking a dedicated Finance Administrator to manage and maintain purchase contracts, ensuring all records are accurate, compliant, and up to date. This role involves raising purchase orders, liaising with suppliers and internal stakeholders, monitoring contract documentation, and providing comprehensive financial administration support across the finance function.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Manage and maintain purchase contracts and purchase orders, ensuring all records are accurate, compliant, and up to date.
- Liaise with suppliers and internal stakeholders regarding contract queries, amendments, and renewals.
- Monitor contract documentation and maintain detailed financial and administrative records.
- Provide comprehensive financial administration support across the finance function.
- Cover the Purchase Ledger function, including invoice processing, matching, coding, posting invoices, and supplier statement reconciliations.
- Resolve supplier queries and account discrepancies, ensuring accurate and up-to-date records.
- Produce and maintain Excel spreadsheets to support financial reporting and analysis.
- Analyse financial data using Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUPs/XLOOKUPs, formulas, and data validation tools.
- Generate reports and reconciliations
- Maintain high levels of accuracy when handling financial data and reporting information.
- Support the finance team with ad hoc analysis and administrative duties as required.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Proven experience in financial administration and purchase ledger.
- Strong skills in supplier reconciliations and invoice processing.
- Proficient in Excel Analysis, including Pivot Tables and VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP.
- Experience in financial reporting, data analysis, and accounts payable.
- Excellent skills in contract administration and stakeholder management.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary package.
- Supportive and collaborative work environment.

title: Finance Officer
description:
Finance Officer

Salary: £32,000-38,000

Location: Reading

We are seeking an experienced, dependable and detail-oriented Finance Officer to join our finance team in Reading. This is a hands-on role covering payroll support, accounts payable and management accounts, alongside wider finance duties as required. It would suit someone who enjoys taking ownership of a defined workload, values stability and wants to become a long-term, trusted member of the finance team. We are looking for someone who is comfortable with established processes and recurring responsibilities, but who also has the experience, resourcefulness and practical know-how to adapt when priorities, systems or business requirements change.

Key Responsibilities

Accounts Payable & Finance Inbox
- Manage the finance inbox and respond to supplier queries in a timely manner
- Process supplier invoices and ensure accurate coding and posting
- Reconcile supplier statements
- Prepare regular payment runs

Management Accounts & Month-End
- Assist with the preparation of monthly management accounts
- Prepare journals, accruals, and prepayments
- Perform balance sheet reconciliations
- Support month-end processes and reporting deadlines

Payroll
- Support the monthly payroll process, ensuring information is complete, accurate and submitted on time
- Process payroll changes including starters, leavers, salary changes, overtime, commission and other adjustments
- Assist with payroll reconciliations and resolve payroll queries
- Maintain accurate payroll records and supporting documentation
- Liaise with employees and relevant internal teams on payroll matters
- Support pension and other payroll-related administration as required
- Provide cover for payroll processing where required
- Maintain confidentiality when handling employee and payroll information

Wider Finance Support
- Provide practical support across the finance team when priorities change, including reconciliations, reporting, payments and other ad hoc finance tasks

Skills & Experience

Essential:
- Previous hands-on experience in a finance role, including accounts payable and exposure to management accounts
- Experience supporting or processing payroll, with a good understanding of payroll controls and confidentiality
- Strong reconciliation skills and high attention to detail
- Ability to manage a recurring workload reliably and meet monthly deadlines
- Good Excel skills and confidence using financial systems
- Practical problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt when processes or priorities change

Desirable:
- Experience using Sage or similar accounting software and payroll systems
- Experience in a multi-entity finance environment

Personal Attributes
- Reliable, organised and methodical
- Comfortable taking ownership of routine and recurring responsibilities
- A steady and dependable team member who is looking for a long-term role
- Flexible and resourceful when unexpected issues or changing priorities arise
- Practical, self-sufficient and willing to help outside core responsibilities when needed

Recruitment Note:

Due to high volumes of applications, we are unable to respond to every candidate individually. If you do not hear from us within 5 days, please assume your application has been unsuccessful. We do read every CV carefully and will contact you if a suitable role arises in the future.

title: Purchase Ledger Assistant
description:
Purchase Ledger Assistant

Location: Berkshire area (office-based 4 days)
Department: Finance

About the Role

An established organisation is seeking a detail-oriented Purchase Ledger Assistant to join its Finance team. This role plays a key part in ensuring supplier invoices, subcontractor payments, reconciliations, and financial records are processed accurately and efficiently.

Working closely with operational and support teams across the business, you will provide proactive support while maintaining high standards of accuracy and compliance.

Key Responsibilities
- Process weekly self-billed subcontractor payments and invoices
- Process supplier invoices and payments in a timely manner
- Manage and resolve expense-related queries through expense management systems
- Complete supplier reconciliations, including open orders, GRNI (Goods Received Not Invoiced), and supplier statements
- Liaise with operational teams to ensure invoices are processed promptly
- Allocate direct debits, standing orders, and other electronic payments
- Monitor and resolve debit balance issues
- Ensure all processing complies with internal controls and company policies
- Respond to supplier and internal stakeholder queries efficiently and professionally
- Maintain process documentation and records
- Provide support and cover for colleagues during periods of absence
- Assist with ad hoc finance projects and additional duties as required

About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:
- Previous Purchase Ledger / Accounts Payable experience
- Experience working in a high-volume processing environment
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to meet deadlines
- A proactive and team-focused approach
- Strong communication and problem-solving skills
- A commitment to maintaining high standards and delivering quality work

What We're Looking For
- Someone who enjoys working as part of a collaborative team
- The ability to follow established procedures and controls
- A positive, flexible attitude and willingness to support colleagues
- A commitment to getting things right first time

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Purchase Ledger professional looking to join a busy finance function where accuracy, teamwork, and continuous improvement are highly valued
